args.prompt: A sprite kit for a cute 2D pixel art game background: exactly 8 separate objects arranged in a clean grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, each object fully visible, well separated with plenty of empty space around it, none touching or overlapping. Soft pastel 16-bit pixel art with hard square chunky pixels, simple flat shading with one highlight tone and one shadow tone, light from the top left, NO dark outlines (soft background art), no anti-aliasing, no text, no labels. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else. Same warm pastel palette family as the reference drawing (lavender, pink and yellow). Theme: COSMIC CANDY CASTLE. The 8 objects are: (1) a tall crystal candy tower in violet and pink, (2) a shorter crystal tower in mint and blue, (3) a fairy-tale candy castle with little flags on a puffy cloud base, (4) a small planet that looks like a swirl lollipop, (5) a small planet that looks like a striped candy ball with a ring, (6) a small planet that looks like a pink donut, (7) a glowing faceted crystal, (8) a cluster of sparkling stardust.
